status.scope_reason: The company formulates and manufactures medical-grade plasticized and rigid PVC compounds used for medical applications including packaging, devices, and films.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Alfavinil is a family-owned manufacturer based in San Martín, Argentina, that produces rigid and plasticized PVC compounds for medicinal applications conforming to European and US Pharmacopoeia standards.

claims.claim: The company reports launching a dedicated research and development initiative in 2018 to develop phthalate-free PVC compounds specifically tailored for the medicinal market, according to the corporate history published on the Alfavinil Website.
The company reports the implementation of phthalate-free medical compound formulations within its specialized PVC production catalog, established in 2018 as part of its regulatory material updates.

The company reports providing a technical-commercial service under its "ALFAvalue" business model to assist customers with custom product development and process optimization, stating that its compounds are formulated according to client specifications, regulations, and processing needs.

The company reports that its manufacturing plant maintains an active ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certification covering its PVC compounding operations, according to the official Alfavinil website.
The company reports historical research and development efforts completed in 2018 focused on developing phthalate-free PVC compounds specifically tailored for the medical market.
The company reports the development and commercial release of heavy metal-free PVC compounds in 2015 and phthalate-free medical compounds in 2018.
